attributes.action: Anti sickness medication for people with emetophobia
attributes.additional_details: people with emetophobia are expected to be medicated the same as everyone else with normal mental health issues when that’s not the case,they see us asking for anti sickness as a safety behaviour and yes in a way it is but it’s not addictive like anxiety meds,people with anxiety and depression get medication to help and that to me is also a safety behaviour  if we are categorising it.If anti sickness for emetophobia is a safety behaviour then everyone who is on meds should also be treat the same
attributes.background: To change the look on people with emetophobia asking for things like anti sicknesses so we can live the life we are life we want to. I don’t think anyone understands how life changing this will be if someone actually took the time to listen and understand.

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We're not sure exactly what you'd like the Government or Parliament to do.

Medication used to treat emetophobia is already funded on the NHS.

You could start a new petition calling for the Government or Parliament to provide funding to make the medication free on the NHS.
